'''Cloud City Police Headquarters''', also known as '''Cloud Police Headquarters''', was a location in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] that served as the headquarters for the [[City/Legends|city's]] [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agency]], the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Cloud Police]]. [[Ken]] was brought to the headquarters after [[Gender/Legends|he]] was arrested for reckless driving. While he was there, [[Zorba Desilijic Tiure|Zorba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] sent a message to the Cloud Police asking that Ken be released into his custody.<ref name="Zorba" />
